input.title: Relationship lending during a trust crisis on the interbank market: A friend in need is a friend indeed
input.authors: Degryse H.; Karas A.; Schoors K.
input.abstract: We exploit uncertainty regarding banks’ involvement in money laundering activities as a natural experiment to study the functioning of the interbank market in uncertain times. We show that bank couples with a stronger relationship (i.e., more frequent and reciprocal interactions before the event)are more likely to continue lending to one another, and at lower interest rates. This is in line with a “helping hand” or “flight to friends” hypothesis during crisis. © 2019 Elsevier B.V.
